Desserts

Cookie-Baked Protein Oatmeal

A warm, chocolate-chip cookie in a ramekin—with oats, banana and a scoop of protein blended right in. Easy enough for breakfast, cozy enough for dessert.

Prep
Not listed
Cook
Not listed
Total
25 min
Difficulty
Not listed
Ingredients
8

Ingredients

  • ½ cup rolled oats (certified gluten-free if needed)
  • ½ ripe banana
  • 1 large egg
  • ½ scoop vanilla protein powder
  • ¼ cup milk of choice, plus 1–2 tbsp if needed
  • Pinch of sea salt
  • ¼ tsp baking soda
  • 1 tbsp dark chocolate chips
  • 1 tsp honey or maple syrup (not included in the macro estimate) (optional)

Amounts are scaled from 1 original servings. Season to taste.

Instructions

  1. Heat oven to 350°F (175°C) and lightly grease a ramekin.
  2. Blend oats, banana, egg, protein powder, milk, salt and baking soda until smooth. If the batter is very thick, blend in another spoonful of milk.
  3. Pour into the ramekin and scatter chocolate chips over the top.
  4. Bake for about 20 minutes, until the center is set and a toothpick comes out mostly clean. Let it cool for 5 minutes before eating.

Cook times may vary when changing batch size.
